title: Linear upper-bound conjecture for the largest singular value
statement:
Let $\sigma_{1,n}$ denote the largest singular value of the matrix associated with index $n$. **Largest-singular-value bound.**

$$
\sigma_{1,n} \leq \sqrt{2.0193n-0.7914}.
$$

This bound is suggested by the numerical homotopy experiment and is presented as a conjecture for the growth of the largest singular value.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.01116

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2021).
source_name: Neil J. Calkin, Eunice Y. S. Chan, Robert M. Corless, David J. Jeffrey and Piers W. Lawrence, “A Fractal Eigenvector”, arXiv:2104.01116 (2021).
